hints: Resolve forces horizontally taking the direction opposite to the 12 N force (to the left) as positive: $P\cos\theta = 12 + 8\cos 30^\circ - 10\cos 45^\circ$.
Resolve forces vertically taking upwards as positive: $P\sin\theta = 10\sin 45^\circ - 8\sin 30^\circ$.
Evaluate both components and use Pythagoras to find $P = \sqrt{(P\cos\theta)^2 + (P\sin\theta)^2}$ and trigonometry for $\theta$.
walkthrough: Set up a Cartesian coordinate system with positive $x$ to the right and positive $y$ upwards.

State the equilibrium conditions:
$$\sum F_x = 0 \quad \text{and} \quad \sum F_y = 0$$

Resolve forces along the horizontal axis:
The $12\text{ N}$ force acts along the positive $x$-axis: $+12$.
The $8\text{ N}$ force acts at $30^\circ$ above the positive $x$-axis: $+8\cos 30^\circ$.
The $10\text{ N}$ force acts in the third quadrant at $45^\circ$ below the negative $x$-axis: $-10\cos 45^\circ$.
The force $P$ acts in the second quadrant at angle $\theta$ above the negative $x$-axis: $-P\cos\theta$.
Form the horizontal equilibrium equation:
$$12 + 8\cos 30^\circ - 10\cos 45^\circ - P\cos\theta = 0$$
$$P\cos\theta = 12 + 8\cos 30^\circ - 10\cos 45^\circ$$
Substitute numerical values:
$$P\cos\theta = 12 + 8(0.866025) - 10(0.707107)$$
$$P\cos\theta = 12 + 6.9282 - 7.0711 = 11.8571\text{ N}$$

Resolve forces along the vertical axis:
The $12\text{ N}$ force has no vertical component.
The $8\text{ N}$ force acts upwards: $+8\sin 30^\circ$.
The $10\text{ N}$ force acts downwards: $-10\sin 45^\circ$.
The force $P$ acts upwards: $+P\sin\theta$.
Form the vertical equilibrium equation:
$$P\sin\theta + 8\sin 30^\circ - 10\sin 45^\circ = 0$$
$$P\sin\theta = 10\sin 45^\circ - 8\sin 30^\circ$$
Substitute numerical values:
$$P\sin\theta = 10(0.707107) - 8(0.5) = 7.0711 - 4 = 3.0711\text{ N}$$

Calculate the magnitude $P$ using Pythagoras theorem:
$$P = \sqrt{(P\cos\theta)^2 + (P\sin\theta)^2}$$
$$P = \sqrt{(11.8571)^2 + (3.0711)^2} = \sqrt{140.5908 + 9.4317} = \sqrt{150.0225} \approx 12.2\text{ N}$$

Calculate the angle $\theta$ using the tangent ratio:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{P\sin\theta}{P\cos\theta} = \frac{3.0711}{11.8571} \approx 0.259005$$
$$\theta = \tan^{-1}(0.259005) \approx 14.5^\circ$$
